card.name: Inside quinidine and rare names
card.fires_on: Mostly the ending 'idine' in 'quinidine' after 'quin' or 'Quin', in drug-interaction lists. It also fires on odd partial words such as 'est' in 'queerest', 'argo' in 'Largo' and 'ett' in a surname.

modes.label: Quinidine ending
modes.description: The closing piece 'idine' of quinidine in lists of interacting drugs.
modes.example: disopyramide, flecainide, lidocaine (systemic), mexiletine, propafenone, quin<<idine>> digoxin ↑ ranolazine ↑

modes.label: Other split rare words
modes.description: The middle or end piece of an uncommon word or name split into parts.

card.plain: It lights up on the last part of the drug name quinidine, and weakly on other oddly split rare words.
